eyebrow: Microsoft Azure Administration, Compute & Storage · Chapter 3
subtitle: Lesson 11 · Azure Compute: Virtual Machines

steps.label: OS disk
steps.sub: exactly one per VM — holds the operating system

steps.label: Data disk
steps.sub: zero or more — app data, kept separate from the OS

steps.label: Premium SSD
steps.sub: high IOPS, low latency — production databases

code:
az disk create \
  --resource-group rg-data \
  --name disk-sql-data01 \
  --size-gb 512 \
  --sku Premium_LRS

az vm disk attach \
  --resource-group rg-data \
  --vm-name vm-sql01 \
  --name disk-sql-data01
caption: Premium_LRS needs a VM size with an "s" in the name, like Standard_D2s_v5.
